name: Kolon TissueGene, Inc.
summary: Kolon TissueGene, Inc. is a biopharmaceutical firm specializing in the advancement of clinical-stage cell-based treatments for osteoarthritis. Its flagship offering is TG-C, a proprietary platform technology that integrates allogeneic primary cells with genetically engineered counterparts. Established by Kwan H. Lee on June 9, 1999, the enterprise maintains its corporate headquarters in Rockville, Maryland.
